title: Custom Flaming Soccer Ball with Name Comforter Set, Machine Washable
description:
Discover the perfect bedding for young soccer enthusiasts with this inspiring comforter set from Jeminise. Designed to ignite passion for the sport, this set helps children dream big while enjoying cozy comfort.

Key Features

  • Soccer Enthusiasm: Ideal for young soccer fans, inspiring them to chase their dreams and celebrate their favorite sport.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88") to fit various bed sizes.
  • Easy to Use: Features a hidden zipper and smooth metal pull for effortless duvet insertion and removal, a convenient alternative to traditional buttons.
  • Superior Manufacturing: Utilizes environmental protection techniques for long-lasting color and prevents fading, with smooth, fine, and compact stitching.
  • Machine Washable: Simple care instructions; wash separately in cold water and air dry for quick drying and a fluffier feel.
  • Included Components: This set includes a duvet cover, two pillowcases, and two shams.
  • Customization: Features text input for personalization, allowing for custom names and numbers.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Duvet Cover Set
Material Polycotton
Fabric Type Polycotton
Pattern Soccer
Selected Design A4
Included Components Duvet Cover
Customization 1 text input
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Selected Size Full
Pillowcase Length 20 inches
Pillowcase Width 20 inches
Pillowcase Quantity 2
Sham Quantity 2
Thread Count 360
Care Instructions Machine Wash
